criteria.note: load + _validate reject every malformed config by name; load returns {} when absent, raises on malformed JSON; the template validates.
resolve_repo fails closed across label/component/field on missing, unknown, and ambiguous signals; never guesses. The component filter asymmetry lets no misroute slip through.
tracker_for_repo returns {tracker, project} for a known repo, raises by name for an undeclared one.
Pure stdlib (json+os), one file read, no writes, no network, deterministic; template ships.
Non-tautological: mutating resolve_repo into a guesser turns the refuses and non-tautology assertions RED. Gate GREEN, selftest 1068.
